name: chartqa
description: ChartQA: structured visual reasoning over charts.

dataset.subset: seeded sample of 128 (seed=42) after sorting by (image path, question)

note: Pinned protocol: lmms-lab/ChartQA test split, raw dataset question rendered through the target's chat template, chart images exported byte-identical to the upstream files, greedy decoding, max_new_tokens=64, sequential verification. Per-row question/image hashes are recorded in benchmarks/prompts/chartqa_v1.jsonl; the export is reproducible from the pinned shard hashes with the same seed. Answers are intentionally not exported (prompt-only benchmark).
